question.text: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Nvidia)
question.resolution_criteria:
Each subquestion will resolve as the diluted earnings per share (EPS) in conformity with US generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) reported in each company's first official quarterly earnings release after September 30, 2026. This is expected to be released no earlier than:

* Apple Q4 FY2026 November 2, 2026 ([source](https://finance.yahoo.com/calendar/earnings?symbol=AAPL))
* AMD Q3 FY2026 November 3, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/AMD/earnings))
* Amazon Q3 FY2026 October 29, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/AMZN/earnings))
* Meta Q3 FY2026 October 21, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/META/earnings))
* Microsoft Q1 FY2027 October 28, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/MSFT/earnings))
* Nvidia Q3 FY 2027 November 25, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/NVDA/earnings))
* SpaceX Q3 FY 2026 October 20, 2026 ([source](https://www.wallstreethorizon.com/spacex-earnings-calendar))
* Tesla Q3 FY 2026 October 21, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/TSLA/earnings))

The earnings reports are typically released on the respective companies' investor relations websites and filed with the [U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)](https://www.sec.gov/search-filings) as a Form 8-K.
question.fine_print:
Only the initially reported figures encompassing the entirety of the quarter will be considered. Any subsequent revisions, corrections, or restatements will not affect resolution. 

If a company does not publicly report earnings after September 30, 2026 and before January 1, 2027 or if it ceases to operate as a standalone public company, that specific subquestion will be **annulled**.

research:
I couldn't find any reported Nvidia Q3 FY2027 GAAP diluted EPS yet. Nothing settles the question as of 2026-10-28. Operating guidance alone implies roughly $2.45, but unpredictable gains or losses on Nvidia's equity investments could move GAAP EPS by $0.20 to $0.50 either way. Those gains made GAAP EPS beat non-GAAP EPS by $0.52 last quarter.

## 1. Resolution source
- The deciding figure is GAAP diluted EPS in Nvidia's Q3 FY2027 press release, filed as an 8-K exhibit on investor.nvidia.com and SEC EDGAR.
- 2026-08-26: The latest value is Q2 FY2027 (quarter ended 2026-07-26). GAAP diluted EPS was $2.46 and non-GAAP was $2.22. Q1 FY2027 was $2.39 GAAP and $1.87 non-GAAP; Q2 FY2026 was $1.08 GAAP. [Nvidia](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-second-quarter-fiscal-2027)
- One Nvidia IR table reportedly lists $2.22 as GAAP, which looks like a labeling error. The newsroom release says $2.46. [IR](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-Second-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/default.aspx)

## 2. Current status
- The quarter almost certainly ended about 2026-10-25, on Nvidia's 13-week pattern. That date is my inference, not one Nvidia has disclosed. Results are not out.
- 2026-10-21: The report date is not officially confirmed. Third-party estimates are Nov 17, 18 or 25, and Kalshi lists Nov 18. Last year Nvidia announced its Q3 call date on Oct 29. [cmelitegroup](https://www.cmelitegroup.com/knowledge-hub/nvidia-earnings-date/), [MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-11-18-nvidia-co-stock/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-27: Nvidia confirmed a $3B investment in Meta. Anthropic has filed for its IPO. (These come from the news items you supplied; I did not verify them separately.) [Invezz](https://invezz.com/it/notizie/2026/10/27/futures-nasdaq-140-punti-5-cose-da-sapere-prima-dellapertura-di-wall-street/)
- 2026-10-23: Intel closed at about $86.96, against about $92.3 on 2026-07-24 near the start of Nvidia's quarter. That points to a small mark-to-market loss on Nvidia's Intel stake. [heygotrade](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/intel-intc-stock-news-october-26-2026/), [Fundlibrary](https://www.fundlibrary.com/Stocks/Detail/intel-corporation/187998)
- 2026-10-14 to 10-20: Neocloud stocks sold off. CoreWeave fell to about $59 to $63; Nvidia holds about 47.2M shares, worth about $5B in mid-August. This suggests a loss of roughly $2B on that stake (my estimate). [24/7 Wall St](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/16/coreweave-and-nebius-sink-9-as-sentiment-index-closes-in-on-extreme-fear/), [WTOP](https://wtop.com/news/2026/08/8-stocks-nvidia-has-invested-in/)
- 2026-09: Reuters reported Nvidia was in talks to invest up to $10B in Anthropic's IPO at about $2T valuation. Anthropic's prior round was at $965B in May. [Pulse2](https://pulse2.com/nvidia-reportedly-in-talks-to-invest-up-to-10-billion-in-anthropic-ipo-at-about-2-trillion-valuation/)
- Q2 10-Q figures (quarter ended 2026-07-26):
  - Publicly held equity securities were $42.8B, plus $5.0B under lock-up.
  - Non-marketable equity securities were $47.9B. These are revalued only when there are observable price changes, such as a new funding round.
  - Remaining equity investment commitments were $25B.
  - Shares outstanding were 24.1B on 2026-08-21.
  
  [10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000075/nvda-20260726.htm)

## 4. Base rates and arithmetic
- GAAP EPS history: $1.08 (Q2 FY26), $2.39 (Q1 FY27), $2.46 (Q2 FY27).
- Equity gains drove the gap between GAAP and non-GAAP: $15.9B in Q1 FY27, $7.8B in Q2 FY27 and $1.35B in Q3 FY26. [Nvidia Q3 FY26](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-third-quarter-fiscal-2026)
- Q3 guidance: revenue of $108.0B ±2%, with no China data center compute revenue assumed. GAAP gross margin of 74.0% ±0.5pt, GAAP operating expenses of about $9.2B, and a full-year tax rate of 16 to 18%.
- My arithmetic with no equity gains:
  - $108B × 74% = $79.9B gross profit.
  - Minus $9.2B opex, plus about $0.3B other income, gives about $71.0B pre-tax.
  - At about 16.5% tax that is about $59.3B net income. Over about 24.2B diluted shares, that is **about $2.45**.
- Sensitivities:
  - Each $1B of pre-tax equity gain or loss is worth about ±$0.034 per share.
  - A 2% revenue beat adds about $0.07.
- Nvidia beat EPS consensus in 7 of its last 8 quarters. Q2 revenue was $96.2B against a $92.07B consensus. [Rex Shares](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/)

## 5. Other forecasts
- Consensus non-GAAP EPS is about $2.47 to $2.53 (MarketBeat $2.47, TipRanks $2.47 from 33 analysts, Chartmill $2.53). Consensus revenue is about $108.8 to $111.4B. Note these are non-GAAP figures, not the GAAP number that resolves the question. [MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-11-18-nvidia-co-stock/), [TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/stocks/nvda/earnings), [Chartmill](https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/NVDA/estimates)
- Polymarket, prices as of 2026-10-28 (none of these is a GAAP EPS market):
  - Q3 non-GAAP gross margin of 73 to 75%: 85%.
  - Data center revenue above $100B: 80.5%; above $105B: 28%; above $110B: 30%. The last two are inconsistent with each other.
- Kalshi labels its earnings-call mention market "Nov 18, 2026".
- I found no market or analyst forecast for GAAP EPS specifically.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- An announcement of the call date, likely in late October or early November.
- The Q3 FY27 release, likely Nov 17 to 18, which is before the question's Nov 25 resolution date. The GAAP figure will depend heavily on:
  - Mark-to-market changes on public stakes, including Intel, CoreWeave, Coherent, Synopsys and Nokia; Intel and CoreWeave look like losses from the prices above.
  - Any observable-price revaluations of private stakes such as OpenAI or Anthropic during the quarter. I could not find any confirmed for the quarter.
- Nvidia's 13F for the quarter ended September 30, due around mid-November, will show its public holdings.
- Intel reports on Oct 29. That cannot change Nvidia's quarter-end marks, but it is useful context.

(a) **Time left:** About 3 to 4 weeks. Nvidia's Q3 FY2027 release is likely around Nov 18, 2026, and no later than about Nov 25. The quarter itself ended around Oct 25.

(b) **Latest known value:** Q2 FY2027 GAAP diluted EPS was $2.46, reported 2026-08-26. That figure included about $7.8B of equity investment gains. Non-GAAP EPS was $2.22.

(c) **If nothing changed:** Midpoint guidance with no equity gains or losses implies GAAP EPS of about $2.45.

(d) **If the current trend continued:** Nvidia usually beats revenue guidance by 2 to 4%. Revenue of about $111 to 112B would give about $2.53 before equity marks. The quarter's public marks look negative: CoreWeave fell sharply (roughly -$2B) and Intel declined (roughly -$1B). That pulls the figure to about $2.42 to 2.47. Private-stake revaluations (OpenAI, Anthropic and others) are unknown and could be large gains.

(e) **Historical variation:** GAAP EPS swings with equity marks. Those have added $0.05 to $0.55 per quarter recently, and each $1B of pre-tax gain or loss is worth about $0.034 per share. Operating EPS grows roughly 5 to 15% a quarter.

(f) **Expert and market expectations:** Non-GAAP consensus is about $2.47 to 2.53. Polymarket puts an 85% chance on a non-GAAP gross margin of 73 to 75%, and data center revenue is likely above $100B. I found no GAAP-specific forecast.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- *Low:* A broad AI-stock selloff into quarter-end produces a $6 to 10B mark-to-market loss on public holdings, together with a smaller revenue beat. GAAP EPS would be around $2.1.
- *High:* A large private revaluation, such as an OpenAI round or a pre-IPO Anthropic pricing, produces a $10 to 15B gain, on top of a strong revenue beat. GAAP EPS would be around $2.9 to 3.0.
